BAY PROCEDURE Tacoma RV Center · Document Library CONCERN Dometic B57915 rooftop air conditioner is not cooling. MODEL Dometic B57915 DATE 2026-10-09 WO# - PRIMARY Dometic Brisk II, page 23. VISUAL FLOWCHART The fan runs and the rooftop unit is not cooling. Peacemaker bypass, then bypass the ceiling selector. Do both bypasses cool? Stay on the bypasses. Do not start on the filter. Replace the ceiling thermostat/selector. YES NO BAY PROCEDURE Bay order · Tacoma RV Center WHAT THIS PATTERN USUALLY MEANS Dometic B57915 turns on and will not blow cold. Confirm the fan runs, then do the Peacemaker bypass at the rooftop unit and report whether it cools. BAY ORDER (START HERE) Step 1: Run the Peacemaker bypass at the rooftop unit Do this: 1. Fan running with no cold air is the no-cool path. 2. Run the Peacemaker bypass at the rooftop unit. 3. If that bypass cools, the unit is making cold air. 4. If it does not cool, stay on that bypass. 5. Do not start on the filter check. Step 2: If the Peacemaker bypass cools, bypass the ceiling selector Do this: 1. If the selector bypass does not cool, stay on it and retest. Step 3: Replace the ceiling thermostat/selector Do this: 1. Both bypasses cool. 2. Replace the ceiling thermostat/selector. 3. That is the confirmed correction per Dometic Brisk II, page 23. DO NOT - Do not start on the filter check. SOURCES (SHOP DOCUMENT LIBRARY) - Dometic Brisk II page 23
